visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs is seen in a close-up, smiling and gently touching her cheek with her index finger. She wears a white and pink checkered sweater. The background is a minimalist, brightly lit indoor space with white walls. Dynamic text bubbles and hearts overlay the screen. (2) The scene shifts to an exterior view of a multi-story urban building in Korea, covered in various colorful signage. It then cuts to a sleek interior wall featuring the silver-colored XENIA CLINIC logo under soft recessed lighting, establishing the setting. (3) The woman appears again, now wearing a white, fluffy, high-collared coat. She smiles brightly as numerous text labels listing beauty treatments appear around her, while the background transitions into a soft, textured white surface. (4) Inside the clinic, a hand is shown writing on a document with a red pen. The woman is then seen in a consultation room, looking into a hand mirror while talking to a consultant, discussing her skin concerns in a professional setting. (5) A rapid montage follows, showing various skin treatments: a red laser dot moving across her forehead, a blue-light LDM device, a thick white gel mask being applied with a brush, and an ultrasound probe being used on her jawline. The setting is a clean, clinical room. (6) A medical professional in gloves performs an injection near the woman's eye area. The camera captures her reacting with a slight wince. She is later seen in a dressing room, adjusting her hair and looking satisfied with the initial process. (7) The final sequence shows a timeline of recovery: Day 1 displays red spots on her cheek; Day 2 shows her eating at a restaurant; Day 3 features her outdoors in sunlight and finally smiling happily at home with glowing skin.
